## US Launches Military Operation in Venezuela, Captures President Maduro

**Caracas, Venezuela & Washington, D.C.** - In a stunning and unprecedented move, the United States launched a military operation in Venezuela on January 3, 2026, capturing President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, in the capital city of Caracas. [wikipedia.org](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGWA4bpn425BJUl7gD53NwA1ou5YNaoMT1IJZcrTj116odpT1_Te1-iYxXOsOuBI6MDLXpHZlefk0tbvVlUqDl-_DdJ7lWndJigKbQixarI_2kjFAPDnkWGYPETHGPzlL-KBPO3UuAcV98O-G77HLmCNmJ7mbNCZ5mDKlLgga_mTQ==) [indiasworld.in](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEOAy4gsw1XvRt6I-OxqpRznMVike2bAbOOQMnaNim1GH1TnxrgsLHGVTJBzHIpdPFJm171NGT4c1L4KhLjIUKdlUW9T1aQnyaW97g95xPoIyAvHtSERhRJhxFHThfwPLhL-jsz79o5uoqJBEn6if-kCfmzuYP3JLiCMK01rFLQ8Mt8YLFgklecXgdP0lfnYUt7SQ7OFz3bTubL6BWN1uVjEA==) The operation, codenamed "Absolute Resolve," began with explosions and airstrikes by over 150 U.S. aircraft on infrastructure in northern Venezuela, paving the way for a special forces team to apprehend the Venezuelan leader. [wikipedia.org](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGWA4bpn425BJUl7gD53NwA1ou5YNaoMT1IJZcrTj116odpT1_Te1-iYxXOsOuBI6MDLXpHZlefk0tbvVlUqDl-_DdJ7lWndJigKbQixarI_2kjFAPDnkWGYPETHGPzlL-KBPO3UuAcV98O-G77HLmCNmJ7mbNCZ5mDKlLgga_mTQ==)

Following his capture, Maduro was flown to the United States and is being held in a New York detention center. [thecable.ng](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHt9XEORSSl3iRh8qcqGFtGIt9Ah8vO6D2e3HuOqffMSsexNXB15M68ymTySUk6nr-Je99lnEfvrOEuTtvF51_x9A3SMUrfA8GqRQ36hSKpMOs9umao4jpupBM5DpN6sUK3OwVwStqep6jsirWg6vmJCbUCOJLka4GHNhTppeWo4GGWcADpFvlyjxSa75_YadHkHHWEdFeqALA6wOs=) [cbsnews.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHcExZfs5PgOV9dzRcafX7BUamIriFa1OJFb-u63HHzeks7s1-bNE6dFYZcaF58ZU1gU_DltbUxTGDC030ONCRDyQODcy_HpxmWm8Co7JhUtxYBEtCYSwFsFca1jJtcP2i9jTlwYhNxQ8yZhP7oHck2DJkA1K70PtcTvJqg325DZFN864-wPFVsUqkT) He is scheduled to appear in a Manhattan federal court on Monday, January 5, to face charges of narco-terrorism, cocaine importation, and weapons possession. [reliefweb.int](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHiouF7Oa5Jv9pjTLIK8NPZjO6AzktTdYzGLDMx7_miyjCiyVR1Jggj_Dr-oNE2jNjKs9XMR3IMBhigJ524OU0OZCHZmowpk5KM6zQ4_XQIVYVL6szhVGyRlydvXTdhbIP3F0eZ4kbtEUZO8m-vSdXRqfRLFZ_fDmI-p4uJKqvtlwkn9-igElntEZBrPDwDZsdYwqCLEUWOCoW1PLKhfMicIcwTPtpJLL1dws4Q0XhC3pmyOOht3_RBtQ5YpknRIL93zRAVCdLqMwVTu1SQ0C4G98Rpzw==) [theguardian.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHstNXGLsWFaj1oKuKkZSH5ZdENmkJJG3kjWUypcfX5unbL3eIZZ3ai5g45-vkyhWHO6OygR8zzB7NmNIyc4h075ILKEfZcW-rursYxXRzopJawIU90fgkDJQhAmfudGjF6dikotoNvXdpCqQQic2HzJAmHI7b4eVIeXMkZhlvvhs7yxKYGgOSdvcOMqJdjZXU7xOhBypvFW541KN06-WDixFusaqZiuqCypAA=) These charges stem from a 2020 indictment alleging that Maduro and other high-ranking Venezuelan officials corrupted state institutions to facilitate drug trafficking into the U.S. [indiasworld.in](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEOAy4gsw1XvRt6I-OxqpRznMVike2bAbOOQMnaNim1GH1TnxrgsLHGVTJBzHIpdPFJm171NGT4c1L4KhLjIUKdlUW9T1aQnyaW97g95xPoIyAvHtSERhRJhxFHThfwPLhL-jsz79o5uoqJBEn6if-kCfmzuYP3JLiCMK01rFLQ8Mt8YLFgklecXgdP0lfnYUt7SQ7OFz3bTubL6BWN1uVjEA==) [theguardian.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHstNXGLsWFaj1oKuKkZSH5ZdENmkJJG3kjWUypcfX5unbL3eIZZ3ai5g45-vkyhWHO6OygR8zzB7NmNIyc4h075ILKEfZcW-rursYxXRzopJawIU90fgkDJQhAmfudGjF6dikotoNvXdpCqQQic2HzJAmHI7b4eVIeXMkZhlvvhs7yxKYGgOSdvcOMqJdjZXU7xOhBypvFW541KN06-WDixFusaqZiuqCypAA=)

President Donald Trump announced the operation on social media, stating the U.S. will "run the country until such time as we can do a safe, proper and judicious transition." [cbsnews.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHcExZfs5PgOV9dzRcafX7BUamIriFa1OJFb-u63HHzeks7s1-bNE6dFYZcaF58ZU1gU_DltbUxTGDC030ONCRDyQODcy_HpxmWm8Co7JhUtxYBEtCYSwFsFca1jJtcP2i9jTlwYhNxQ8yZhP7oHck2DJkA1K70PtcTvJqg325DZFN864-wPFVsUqkT) [cbsnews.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH0Wl9DmKNZPPNUlaT6ZyTl52i85F38HDoZsEXQGj3W0IH7184zZOBhFD4O4bOO6xDuWfmc6nbmGtRMJKBkmaUnJCpPBgDR5xsmNM0HZY4hWNS-yShE78QjNuFRraNIIr-dZBLh8FlLWbFycGsnAxK2cWq3uJS2DHlaXhD56qxa)

In response to the power vacuum, Venezuela's Supreme Tribunal of Justice ordered Vice President Delcy Rodríguez to assume the presidency. [wikipedia.org](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGWA4bpn425BJUl7gD53NwA1ou5YNaoMT1IJZcrTj116odpT1_Te1-iYxXOsOuBI6MDLXpHZlefk0tbvVlUqDl-_DdJ7lWndJigKbQixarI_2kjFAPDnkWGYPETHGPzlL-KBPO3UuAcV98O-G77HLmCNmJ7mbNCZ5mDKlLgga_mTQ==) Rodríguez denounced the capture as a "kidnapping" and an "imperialist attack," but has since adopted a more conciliatory tone. [wikipedia.org](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGWA4bpn425BJUl7gD53NwA1ou5YNaoMT1IJZcrTj116odpT1_Te1-iYxXOsOuBI6MDLXpHZlefk0tbvVlUqDl-_DdJ7lWndJigKbQixarI_2kjFAPDnkWGYPETHGPzlL-KBPO3UuAcV98O-G77HLmCNmJ7mbNCZ5mDKlLgga_mTQ==) [scantv.al](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoLVsQrJLegWUNj2wMrYbqe7rbUWYDLiUWtKaUHo82G0iq7zEVYqBbM45dq0Iusf7KdSG7AAvnqs0W-i3lNIffLpSKWXllDUaLM0fzORPDa3cLRW_XV9ywSR3YyGLh9w46UHZ7qoykZSkW5GfGfGbN09Pi-CpHdAoWtXVwGBqpZ77y957-zXK0gF-LXytX9HlSdwQcGKeSLxD5Bfb9ZFogE5ZcgsedKVc=) On January 5, she invited the U.S. government to collaborate on a "joint development" agenda within the framework of international law, stating, "our peoples and our region deserve peace and dialogue, not war." [scantv.al](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHoLVsQrJLegWUNj2wMrYbqe7rbUWYDLiUWtKaUHo82G0iq7zEVYqBbM45dq0Iusf7KdSG7AAvnqs0W-i3lNIffLpSKWXllDUaLM0fzORPDa3cLRW_XV9ywSR3YyGLh9w46UHZ7qoykZSkW5GfGfGbN09Pi-CpHdAoWtXVwGBqpZ77y957-zXK0gF-LXytX9HlSdwQcGKeSLxD5Bfb9ZFogE5ZcgsedKVc=) [globaltimes.cn](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE3dYMp8CLAMJlgoNCuz1sZlM8b0cZjVC3-BrV_Ow4kCsH6SQ2ViH5z0XMgNRm5LpSnPfuS-psWjkzi1HS2ZUxMHOLwR_ybvI79U95cbFbPU9vc3WaGYxPuOh-zQk1avfRM-7O65Tl6NvVAIsU_C7lHj6GnZn_jl6WGNyeb0txB75LZYIGqh-wJXFZW) This came after President Trump threatened further military action if Venezuela does not cooperate with U.S. efforts to open its oil industry and combat drug trafficking. The security situation in Venezuela remains tense, with reports of panic buying of food and fuel. The U.S. military action follows months of escalating tensions, including a significant U.S. military buildup in the Caribbean, strikes on alleged drug trafficking vessels, and expanded sanctions. grounding_supports.segment_text: **Caracas, Venezuela & Washington, D.C.** - In a stunning and unprecedented move, the United States launched a military operation in Venezuela on January 3, 2026, capturing President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, in the capital city of Caracas.

The operation, codenamed "Absolute Resolve," began with explosions and airstrikes by over 150 U.S. aircraft on infrastructure in northern Venezuela, paving the way for a special forces team to apprehend the Venezuelan leader.
Following his capture, Maduro was flown to the United States and is being held in a New York detention center.
He is scheduled to appear in a Manhattan federal court on Monday, January 5, to face charges of narco-terrorism, cocaine importation, and weapons possession.
These charges stem from a 2020 indictment alleging that Maduro and other high-ranking Venezuelan officials corrupted state institutions to facilitate drug trafficking into the U.S.
President Donald Trump announced the operation on social media, stating the U.S. will "run the country until such time as we can do a safe, proper and judicious transition."
He further asserted that the U.S. is "in charge" of Venezuela and intends to "get the oil flowing."
Secretary of State Marco Rubio clarified that while the U.S. does not plan to govern directly, it will enforce an "oil quarantine" to influence policy.
In response to the power vacuum, Venezuela's Supreme Tribunal of Justice ordered Vice President Delcy Rodríguez to assume the presidency.
Rodríguez denounced the capture as a "kidnapping" and an "imperialist attack," but has since adopted a more conciliatory tone.

On January 5, she invited the U.S. government to collaborate on a "joint development" agenda within the framework of international law, stating, "our peoples and our region deserve peace and dialogue, not war."
This came after President Trump threatened further military action if Venezuela does not cooperate with U.S. efforts to open its oil industry and combat drug trafficking.
The security situation in Venezuela remains tense, with reports of panic buying of food and fuel.
Humanitarian field operations have been suspended nationwide.
The streets of Caracas were reported to be deserted and tense following the attack, with some neighborhoods losing power.
The U.S. military action follows months of escalating tensions, including a significant U.S. military buildup in the Caribbean, strikes on alleged drug trafficking vessels, and expanded sanctions.
The operation has drawn sharp international condemnation.
The UN Security Council is set to hold an emergency meeting at the request of Venezuela, with support from Russia and China.
UN Secretary-General António Guterres expressed deep alarm, calling the U.S. actions a "dangerous precedent."
Germany has demanded that the U.S. explain the legal basis for its actions to the international community.
Iran and China have called for Maduro's immediate release.
Meanwhile, Switzerland has frozen any assets linked to Maduro.
